name: Daniel Y. Li
focus: Single-cell CRISPR perturbation and in vivo models of SMC cell-state regulation
bio: Daniel trained at UC San Diego, the NIH and the Cleveland Clinic Lerner College of Medicine, where he studied diet, microbiome and cardiovascular disease as a Sarnoff Fellow. After internal medicine residency and cardiology fellowship at Stanford, he completed his postdoctoral work in the Quertermous Lab. He combines single-cell CRISPR perturbation in vitro with transgenic mouse models to identify smooth muscle cell regulators of coronary artery disease.
